title: A lane's push to its own branch is refused while that branch is in an open, ready integration PR
why: Lane push-head-upstream-name (session_013NEJL1YxsYqim39RK6JeZP), 05:12-05:25 CST Nov 9: it pushed main merges to #2199 and #2327 (heads 39432db98, 63d71001a) while runner 8's batch 68 (#2426), built from their earlier heads, was running CI. A lane in a running batch holds its head, but no check stopped the push. Harm: the batch confirm sees a moved head, and work is redone.
note: #2378 (step batch-freeze-lane-set-enforce) does not refuse it: it only detects a moved head at the next `--batch-build`, and nothing in guard.py, guard_push_delete.py or guard_merge.py refuses it (coordinator, 05:47 CST Nov 9, from #2378's lane). The lane proposed lane-head-holds-in-batch, an ask or a read of open batch PRs before a push; the coordinator chose a refusal. It touches the push guard, so it starts after batch 68 merges. Filed 05:48 CST Nov 9. Batch 68 merged (#2449, 11:55 CST Nov 9): free to start. Lane session_013NEJL24NSUGQwdDXK4sqrb started 12:13 CST Nov 9 (coordinator).
